The '''droid ion blast Mark I''', also known as the "'''Scrambler'''", was a weapon designed by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]] to destroy the electronics of enemy [[Droid/Legends|droids]] by sending a pulse of highly-charged ions. This weapon was marketed toward beings who were faced with the threat of massive droid [[Army/Legends|armies]].

==Behind the scenes==
The droid ion blast Mark I's only appearance was in [[Obsidian Entertainment]]'s [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]. The item requires the Droid Upgrade Class 1 feat to equip, which all droids have.
